metadata.description: Skills for prose that does not read as AI generated, and for code a reviewer can check at a glance.

plugins.name: human-writing
plugins.description: Word and punctuation choice. Removes the vocabulary and punctuation patterns that mark writing as AI generated.

plugins.name: human-structure
plugins.description: What a message says and how it is shaped: length, ordering, prose versus lists, and whether a sentence carries information.

plugins.name: elegant-coding
plugins.description: The default working mode for software work. Code whose correctness is visible at a glance: invalid states made unrepresentable rather than guarded against, few branches, and a diff a reviewer can check quickly.

plugins.name: larper
plugins.description: Teach the domain behind a feature before any design or code exists. A short assessment, then one teaching message.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea, one round of questions per frontier of the design tree.

plugins.name: odoo-upgrade-v18-to-v19
plugins.description: Upgrade Odoo modules from version 18 to version 19: breaking changes, renamed APIs, and the migration steps a module needs.

plugins.name: toast-notify
plugins.description: Windows toast notification when Claude finishes a turn, showing the session title and last message. Requires WSL and the BurntToast PowerShell module.
